text:
maria: Hi team — customer reports their free trial was blocked by our fraud checks. Asking for a manual review so they can start. Account: acc_7b2f4, email: tempuser@guerrillamail.com, phone provided +1-415-555-0199. They say they need this for a time-sensitive demo tomorrow.

ian: Thanks. Can you paste the IP and any headers we have? Also whether they attempted to redeem a promo code or used multiple cards.

maria: IP: 45.77.123.14 (AS394406 OVH SAS). UA: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64). Flags shown in admin UI: disposable_email, vpn_proxy, device_fp_mismatch. No promo code used, single card attempt (declined). Customer provided a selfie and said phone verification is OK.

maria: Repro steps for ops: run the internal review endpoint — here's the curl we used:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  "https://admin.internal.redwood/reviews?account=acc_7b2f4" \

# response shows: risk_score: 87, flags: [disposable_email, vpn_proxy, device_fp_mismatch]
```

ops-bot: Automated risk summary for acc_7b2f4 — risk_score=87; flags=disposable_email,vpn_proxy,device_fp_mismatch; recent_sessions=3 (2 from same ASN).

sophie: High risk but customer wants to verify. If they complete phone KBA + selfie we can consider a temporary override. Recommend: 24h limited trial (token cap + rate limits) while fraud ops monitors. :thinking_face:

maria: Customer is willing to do phone KBA now. They already sent a selfie and a picture of government ID via support portal. Requesting temporary grant so the demo isn't blocked.

ian: I ran extra checks — device fingerprint has inconsistent timezone + IP from cloud provider. Email domain is disposable. Given ID selfie and phone KBA this looks borderline. I can approve a 24h manual override with strict limits (and enable intensive monitoring). Command I'll run:

```
/admin/grant_trial acc_7b2f4 --duration 24h --rate_limit=60rpm --token_cap=5000 --note "manual override after phone KBA/selfie; monitor"
```

nate: Executed the grant, update applied. User notified that trial is active for 24h with reduced quota. Ticket updated: #SUP-4821.

sophie: I'll take monitoring handoff. If we see sudden high-volume usage or new cards/regions, we'll revoke and escalate. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: Closing loop with customer now. Will attach KBA artifacts to the ticket and ping fraud ops if anything else shows up.
